subject: Web Development
title: The State of JavaScript Today
description: A quick win: understand The State of JavaScript Today.

hook.text: A language hacked together in ten days now runs on every device with a screen.

buildup.text: JavaScript powers browsers, servers, mobile apps, desktops, embedded devices, and even space.

discovery.text: It has the largest developer community, the most packages, and the widest reach of any language.

twist.text: Its quirks remain. Comparing [] == false returns true, and nobody can explain why intuitively.

climax.text: JavaScript isn't the best language at anything. It's just everywhere, and that's enough.
